no_helmet.legal_provision: Section 194D, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
no_helmet.official_source: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019), Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Gazette of India
no_helmet.notes: Whoever drives a motorcycle or causes or allows a motorcycle to be driven in contravention of the provisions of section 129 or the rules or regulations made thereunder shall be punishable with a fine of one thousand rupees and he shall be disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.

triple_riding.display_name: Carrying More Than Permitted Riders (Triple Riding)
triple_riding.legal_provision: Section 194C, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
triple_riding.official_source: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019), Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Gazette of India
triple_riding.notes: Whoever drives a motorcycle or causes or allows a motorcycle to be driven in contravention of the provisions of section 128 or the rules or regulations made thereunder shall be punishable with a fine of one thousand rupees and he shall be disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.

wrong_side.display_name: Driving Against Authorised Flow of Traffic (Wrong Direction)
wrong_side.legal_provision: Section 184(f) r/w Section 119/177, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended by Act 32 of 2019)
wrong_side.official_source: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019 (Act No. 32 of 2019), Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Gazette of India
wrong_side.notes: Driving against the authorized flow of traffic constitutes driving dangerously under Section 184(f), punishable with a fine of up to five thousand rupees for the first offence.
